title: Initial-code oracle characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. The initial-code oracle accepts the encoding $\langle x,\langle \mathrm{bits}(u),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle$ if and only if that encoding belongs to the language of valid initial configuration codes for $N$.
